title: The project's emblem shows in the dashboard header and as the favicon
description: master emblem set stores a valid SVG and the served dashboard shows it beside the project name and as the favicon, rendered as an image; an SVG with a script element, an onload attribute, an external href or over 8 KB is refused with the reason; without an emblem the default icon shows.

steps.name: without an emblem the default icon shows
master emblem set stores a valid SVG
the dashboard shows the emblem in the header and as the favicon
invalid SVGs are refused with the reason and the emblem stays
